websiteAnalysis.structured:
## Website Overview
The business 'Fresso Coffee & Tea' uses an Instagram profile (https://www.instagram.com/fressocafe) as its primary online presence. The site is not a traditional website but a social media page, which limits its structure and content depth. The profile acts as a content feed and community hub.

## Site-Wide Structure
**Navbar:** Instagram's native top navigation bar is present, providing access to Home, Search, Reels, Messages, and Notifications. The business-specific navigation is limited to the profile's own links: Posts, Followers, Following.
**Footer:** No traditional footer exists. The profile bio section serves a similar purpose.
**Pages Found:** The crawler identified the main profile page and several individual post/reel pages. No dedicated pages for services, about, contact, or menu exist within this structure.

## Homepage (Instagram Profile Page)
**Headings/Bio:** The profile bio states: 'fressocafe / We’re so excited to share that Fresso is GRAND OPENING on New Year’s Day (tomorrow) at NOON!!' It includes promotional details for the grand opening event (first 100 guests get a $3 drink, then 20% off all coffee and milk tea drinks). Additional text updates mention matcha drinks being back and thank the community.
**Sections:** The page is organized into a grid of posts (14 total). Sections are defined by Instagram: Posts, Reels, Tagged. No custom sections.
**Services/Products Listed:** Products are inferred from post captions and promotions: coffee, milk tea, matcha drinks, smoothies. No formal menu or price list is presented.
**Contact Details:** No phone number, email address, or physical address is visible in the bio or posts crawled. Contact is presumably through Instagram Direct Messages.
**Testimonials:** No dedicated testimonial section. Social proof is shown via follower count (3,025) and likes/comments on individual posts.
**Calls-to-Action:** Primary CTAs are social: 'Follow to stay up to date!!' and engagement prompts within post captions. A promotional CTA for the grand opening event is present.
**Media:** 14 image/video posts are visible on the profile grid. Individual post pages contain numerous images (23-28 per crawled post). Content appears to be promotional, behind-the-scenes, and community-focused.

## Individual Post Pages
Each post page (e.g., /p/DWY1BtpDuNK/) contains a single image carousel or video reel with a caption. These are content deep-dives but lack structured business information. They serve as marketing and engagement touchpoints.

## Overall Organisation
The 'website' is a linear, chronological feed organised by post date. It is excellent for real-time updates, community building, and visual marketing but poor as a standalone business information hub. Critical business details (location, hours, full menu, contact info) are absent or buried in ephemeral post captions.
improvements: Create a dedicated business website with a proper domain (e.g., www.fressocafe.com) to establish a professional online presence.
On the new website, create a clear 'Contact' page with the physical address, phone number, email, and a map.
On the new website, publish a detailed 'Menu' page with all drink categories, items, descriptions, and prices.
On the new website, create an 'About Us' page telling the business story, mission, and team.
On the new website, add a 'Hours of Operation' page/section prominently on the homepage or footer.
Link the Instagram profile from the new website, but do not rely on it as the primary source of information.
Add the physical business address and phone number to the Instagram profile bio immediately.
Create Instagram Story Highlights for permanent access to key info like 'Menu', 'Location', 'Hours', and 'Events'.
Use a link-in-bio tool (like Linktree) on the Instagram profile to direct visitors to a menu PDF or contact form until a website is built.
Collect and feature customer testimonials/reviews in a structured way on the new website, not just in social comments.
Implement clear calls-to-action on the new website for ordering online, signing up for a loyalty program, or booking catering.
Ensure the business is listed on Google My Business with accurate NAP (Name, Address, Phone) and hours to improve local search.
websiteAnalysis.scoreReason: It does well in building a social following (3,025 followers) and using visual content for promotion, but the score is severely dragged down by the complete lack of a dedicated website, missing essential business information, and reliance on a platform not designed for core business discovery.
